supplement.seed_rule: rotation_seed(canonical edit id) of control_seeds.json:rotation (A5.3.3): SHA256 of the UTF-8 bytes '20261107:rotation:' + id, first eight bytes big-endian, mod 2^63; the registered rule of the forty, keyed by the supplementary id (no new domain, counter or offset); one torch generator per edit, shared across its tensors in sorted-name order; the ladders carry the same seed
